verdict.rationale: Decagon explicitly offers a Voice product ('Voice AI agents built for natural, multilingual conversations') and states integrations let the agent 'retrieve data, take action, and handle escalations smoothly across chat, email, and voice channels with no custom code required,' implying shared knowledge/actions across channels; proactive-agents also supports outbound calls. However, this is all vendor documentation with no independent/hands-on validation of call quality, latency, or parity of capabilities between chat and voice. Missing for 10: independent or customer-reported evidence of voice call quality/parity, technical detail on how AOPs/actions execute identically in voice vs chat, and case-study proof of voice deployment success.
